meta.narrative_direction: 부정형 — 김정은이 제 손으로 열어 준 군부·보위성 돈줄이 제 지휘체계보다 커지자 스스로 잘라내는 권력 내부 균열·숙청 서사(concept.md 앵글: 「시킨 것도 김정은이고 잘라내는 것도 김정은이다」). 승리·역전 요소가 없으므로 9장 전부 부정형. ⛔ 한국은 당사자가 아니므로 태극기·한국 인물·한국 무기를 일절 넣지 않는다(반증 레퍼 003이 태극기 대비 구도로 0.2배). ⛔ 김정은에게 눈물·위축·식은땀을 주지 않는다 — 그리는 것은 동정받는 약자가 아니라 자기 함정에 빠진 강자다.

meta.prompt_prefix: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the scene fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge as a single full-bleed image — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is the same continuous scene rendered dark, smoky and free of detail so overlay text stays readable, while all faces, flags, weapons and key objects sit entirely within the upper five-eighths. Anything held or carried sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. photoreal current-affairs broadcast composite: every person, flag and location is a real photograph, sharp and true to life — faces keep real skin texture, pores, stray hair and natural shadow, and fabric keeps a visible weave. Over that photographic base sit broadcast graphic treatments: a bold colour field, cracked-glass shards, torn and scorched edges, a hard vignette, heavy atmospheric haze and fire glow. Dramatic hard lighting, one dominant colour drowning the frame, every part of the upper five-eighths packed edge to edge with elements and no empty space, cinematic wide-angle, very high contrast. NOT an oil painting, NOT brushwork or impasto, NOT a matte painting, NOT anime, NOT an illustration, NOT a 3d render
meta.prompt_suffix: no title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no lower-third news banner, no watermark. Apart from the Korean Hangul labels and numerals named above — which must be rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms — do not invent any other words or letterforms anywhere in the image.
meta.negative_prompt: oil painting, brushwork, impasto, painterly, matte painting, illustration, anime, 3d render, cartoon, South Korean flag, taegukgi, glowing eyes, tears, weeping, letterbox bar, empty panel

thumbnails.concept_ko: verified-data 8절 — 7월 11일 특별 합동그루빠가 평양 대성구역 외화상점을 덮쳤고, 현장에서 숨기지도 않은 채 봉지에 담긴 달러·위안 뭉치가 나왔다. 이 편의 그림 한 장이 이 장면이라 1번에 세웠다. 부정형 판정 근거는 권력기관이 자기 돈줄을 뒤엎는 국면이라는 것. 무명 민간인 대신 제복 검열 집단을 세웠다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the nearest inspector is framed from the chest up and his head touches the top edge, his face spanning the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the rest of the column progressively smaller and hazier behind him. A night raid inside a Pyongyang foreign-currency shop. Foreground right: a column of North Korean state inspection officers in olive drab tunics and red armbands pushing in through the doorway; the nearest one has his jaw set hard, eyes narrowed and locked straight down onto the counter, brows flat and low, mouth a thin line, no sweat and no pity, one gloved hand pressing a folded inspection order flat against the glass as he leans in. Mid-ground centre and left: a long glass counter heaped with thick bundles of US hundred-dollar notes and Chinese yuan notes spilling out of ordinary plastic shopping bags, toppled luxury watch cases, a smashed display shelf, loose notes still drifting in the air. Background: an enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — hung across the entire back wall as real woven cloth with deep folds, its edges charred black and soot staining the creases, colours desaturated and grimy. Above the counter a shop signboard carries the word "외화상점" in Korean Hangul, crisp and legible; the ledger pages scattered under it are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Hard orange firelight rakes in from the left through the doorway, black smoke pooling along the ceiling, the bottom of the frame continuing as the same dark unlit shop floor with no detail.

thumbnails.concept_ko: verified-data 8절 — 상점 뒤를 봐주던 구역 안전원들이 자기 사무실에서 그대로 붙잡혀 갔다. 「두려워할 대상이던 조직이 잡혀가는 조직이 됐다」는 이 편의 반전을 접촉(팔을 잡는 손)으로 물리화했다. 국가보위성이라는 이름 자체가 사라진 개편(추가 리서치)을 금 간 현판으로 겹쳐 놓았다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the arrested officer is framed from the chest up dead centre and his head touches the top edge, his face spanning the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the two escorts slightly smaller on either side. Inside a North Korean security office at night. Two inspection officers in dark tunics grip the upper arms of a state security officer and walk him out from behind his own desk; the arrested man's mouth hangs slightly open, his eyes are wide and unfocused looking past the camera, his inner brows have collapsed upward and his shoulders have sunk, his cap knocked askew. Mid-ground: his own desk still covered with plastic shopping bags split open and spilling banded dollar bundles, a toppled brass desk nameplate, an overturned chair. Behind him on the wall a heavy plaque reading "국가보위성" in Korean Hangul, crisp and legible, with a jagged crack splitting straight through it and cracked-glass shards radiating out; the paperwork pinned beside it is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Filling the left wall a large North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — real woven cloth, scorched along the hem, colours dull and muted. Harsh orange firelight slashes through the window blinds across all three men, heavy smoke haze in the air, the lower part of the room falling away into unlit darkness.

thumbnails.concept_ko: verified-data 8절 — 박희철 단죄 12일 만에 검열이 전군으로 번졌고, 군사교육기관에서는 사진 한 장 찍는 것도 조심하는 분위기가 됐다. 인물 클로즈업이 아니라 제복 집단 대열로 「전군」의 규모를 보여주는 자리로 썼다. 표정은 공포가 아니라 굳은 경직 — 동정 유발을 피한다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the nearest officer stands in the right third framed from the chest up with his head touching the top edge, his face spanning the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the rank behind him receding progressively smaller and hazier into the frame. A dark inspection hall in a North Korean military academy. A long column of army officers in olive dress tunics stands frozen at attention, packed shoulder to shoulder and receding deep into the hall; the nearest officer stares dead ahead past the camera, jaw muscles bunched, lips pressed into a hard flat line, eyes unblinking and dry, both hands gripping the sling of the rifle across his chest at mid height. Mid-ground: a raised inspection table stacked with confiscated ledgers, a mounted situation board carrying the word "전군검열" in Korean Hangul, crisp and legible, its lower rows of entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Background: an enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — stretched across the entire rear wall as real woven cloth with deep hanging folds, the lower edge charred and torn into ragged strips, soot in the creases, colours drained and grimy. Raking orange firelight from the left throws every face into hard relief while black smoke chokes the ceiling; the floor beneath the column continues as the same hall rendered dark and detail-free.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목 슬롯 4 「제 손으로 잘라낸 김정은」의 시각적 이행. verified-data 8절의 친필 서명 지시문(옛 보위원들의 「소박한 청렴과 가난」을 본받으라)을 김정은 손에 쥐여 주고, 뒤에서는 그가 키운 무역회사가 타게 했다. 시킨 사람과 자르는 사람이 한 화면에 있다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Kim Jong Un is framed from the chest up dead centre and his head touches the top edge, his face spanning the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height. Kim Jong Un (leader of North Korea) stands centre frame in a dark high-collar suit, holding one single sheet of paper up at mid chest height and reading it, his eyes cast down onto the page, inner brows pressed hard down, lips clamped shut and pushed forward, chin tucked, no sweat and no tears — the face of a man signing off on someone else's ruin. Mid-ground behind him on both sides: stacks of trade ledgers burning openly on a long table, a collapsing trading-company signboard tipping out of the flames, banded dollar and yuan notes lifting and blackening in the heat. Background: an enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — filling the whole rear wall as real woven cloth with deep folds, its upper edge charred and eaten through with burn holes, colours dull and stained. Orange firelight comes in as a hard key from below left so his face stays bright against a black smoke-choked background, the bottom of the frame continuing as dark smoke with no detail.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목 슬롯 2+4 「김정은이 키운 군부 돈줄 → 제 손으로 잘라냈다」를 한 화면 좌우로 갈랐다. 좌측은 그가 키운 것(무역회사 컨테이너·인공기), 우측은 잘려 나가는 것(호송되는 제복 간부 대열). 두 진영 대비가 아니라 한 진영 내부의 절단이므로 경계는 균열선이 아니라 불기둥으로 나눴다.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 001은 「군중이 김정은을 끌어내리는」 그림이었는데, 우리 편은 「김정은이 자기 사람을 끌어내리는」 그림이다 — 끌어내리는 손의 방향이 정반대다. / [남김] ① 카메라 시점(정면 아이레벨, 인물이 화면 정중앙) — 바꿈 후보 아님 ② 중앙 인물 얼굴이 화면을 지배하는 클로즈업 ③ 좌우 대칭 붕괴 요소(좌=사람이 끌려나가는 쪽, 우=불타는 쪽) ④ 어두운 배경 + 화염 오렌지·딥레드 지배 + 얼굴에만 붉은 키라이트, 상단 5/8 빈틈없이 꽉 참 / [바꿈] ① 좌측 주먹 든 성난 군중 → 호송되는 제복 간부 대열(외부 압력 → 내부 균열) ② 우측 불타는 김정은 초상화 액자 → 화염 속에 무너지는 무역회사 간판과 흩날리는 달러 뭉치 ③ 중앙 표정: 식은땀·충혈된 눈(궁지 몰린 약자) → 땀 하나 없는 냉랭한 정면 노려봄(잘라내는 강자).
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Kim Jong Un is framed from the chest up dead centre at eye level, facing the camera straight on, his head touching the top edge and his face spanning the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height; everything else is smaller and packed in around him. Kim Jong Un (leader of North Korea) fills the centre of the frame in a dark high-collar suit, staring straight down the lens with cold flat eyes, brows level, nostrils flared, lips pressed and pushed forward, skin dry with no sweat and no tears, lit by a hard red-orange key from below so his face burns bright against the smoke. Left third, behind and below him: a column of senior officers in dress tunics being marched out under escort, arms held, heads dropped, passing a cracked concrete wall plaque reading "조직지도부" in Korean Hangul, crisp and legible, the smaller lettering beneath it printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Right third: a trading-company signboard collapsing inside a wall of flame, a steel filing cabinet burst open, banded dollar and yuan bundles blown loose and burning as they lift through the fire. Behind everything an enormous North Korean flag — broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — stretched wall to wall as real woven cloth with deep folds, edges charred black and eaten through with burn holes, colours desaturated and grimy. Orange and deep red drown the entire frame, black smoke fills the upper corners, cracked-glass shards and a hard vignette close the edges, and the bottom of the frame continues as the same scene rendered dark, smoky and free of detail.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 001은 「군중이 김정은을 끌어내리는」 그림이었는데, 우리 편은 「김정은이 자기 사람을 끌어내리는」 그림이다 — 이번엔 그 결과로 자리 자체가 비어 버렸다. / [남김] ① 카메라 시점(정면 아이레벨, 인물이 화면 정중앙) ② 중앙 인물이 화면의 주인인 구도 ③ 좌우 대칭 붕괴 요소 ④ 화염 오렌지·딥레드 지배 + 얼굴에만 붉은 키라이트, 상단 5/8 밀도 / [바꿈] ① 좌측 먹물 뒤집어쓴 동상과 군중 → 주인이 사라진 빈 책상 줄과 쓰러진 명패(verified-data 3절 「자리에 값이 붙은 구조」) ② 불의 출처: 폭동의 불 → 장부·서류가 타는 불(내부 처분) ③ 거리감: 얼굴 중심 → 상반신이 들어오는 넓은 컷, 우측에 끌려나가는 제복 간부 상반신을 함께 넣어 대치를 만든다.
